name: Carrot Fufu
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 tsp psyllium husk powder or xanthan gum

steps: Blend the chopped carrot until smooth.
Transfer the carrot to the cheesecloth, and squeeze out all the water from the carrot paste.
Cook the carrot paste in a pot over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Stir in the psyllium husk to thicken and bind the fufu.

culture.text: Fufu is a pounded meal found in West African cuisine originally made from boiled cassava, plantains, and cocoyam. Fufu's prevalence in West Africa has been noted in local literature, such as Chinua Achebe's Things Fall Apart.
